title: FACE IDENTITY
prompt:
Prompt:
FACE IDENTITY
Beautiful adult South Korean woman in her early 20s. Warm fair porcelain Korean skin with soft peach undertones, delicate oval face, elegant V-line jaw, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes, subtle aegyo-sal, naturally glossy rosy lips, soft Korean makeup, gentle blush, long natural eyelashes, calm relaxed expression with a soft closed-lip smile.

BODY
Exactly 163 cm tall. Naturally feminine slim physique with elegant shoulders, defined collarbones, graceful neck, toned feminine core, subtle upper abdominal definition, visible oblique lines, delicate waist, natural V-line, softly rounded hips, long slender legs, and a naturally full proportional bust with realistic softness, natural gravity, believable weight distribution, and anatomically correct shape.

OUTFIT
Faithfully recreate the outfit from the reference image.

Inner Top:
Ivory textured bandeau top made from soft boucle-like woven fabric with subtle floral texture. Straight horizontal neckline, fitted around the bust, slightly thick handcrafted-looking fabric, securely fitted while naturally contouring the body.

Outer Layer:
Lightweight ivory silk chiffon cardigan worn completely open. Oversized relaxed sleeves with dropped shoulders, soft flowing translucent fabric, naturally slipping slightly off both shoulders, draping loosely along the arms and moving gently with the breeze.

Bottom:
Elegant ivory satin draped maxi skirt made from smooth silk charmeuse with rich natural sheen. Soft diagonal draping and gathered folds concentrated toward the right hip, creating luxurious fluid movement.

The waistband is extremely ultra-low-rise, sitting evenly around the entire circumference at the lowest part of the hip bones rather than dipping only at the center front. Front, side hips, and back maintain the same low height with a slight natural anatomical curve, allowing the skirt to hang naturally from the pelvis while exposing the lower abdomen, hip bones, waistline, and subtle feminine V-line. Avoid a V-shaped front-only waistband or higher side rise.

Accessories:
Minimal silver necklace with a tiny pendant, large elegant silver floral statement ring, natural nude manicure. No bracelets.

SCENE
Traditional luxury Japanese ryokan overlooking a peaceful Kyoto-style garden filled with vibrant green maple trees, moss-covered stones, a small koi pond, and wooden architecture. Standing beside a large open wooden doorway leading toward the garden.

COMPOSITION
Vertical 2:3 smartphone lifestyle portrait. Medium shot framed from approximately mid-thigh upward. Subject occupies around 75% of the frame while the lush Japanese garden remains clearly visible. Natural candid composition rather than fashion editorial.

POSE
Leaning gently against the wooden doorway. Left hand lightly resting on the wooden railing. Right arm hanging naturally with relaxed wrist slightly bent. One shoulder slightly lower as the cardigan slips naturally off both shoulders. Head gently tilted downward while looking softly toward the garden.

EXPRESSION
Soft thoughtful expression, relaxed downward gaze, closed lips, elegant quiet peaceful mood.

LIGHTING
Soft overcast natural daylight filtered through lush maple leaves. Gentle green ambient bounce from surrounding foliage. Smooth diffused highlights across the face, shoulders, collarbones, and satin fabric. Natural smartphone HDR with balanced exposure.

STYLE / QUALITY
Ultra photorealistic luxury Korean resort aesthetic with Japanese ryokan atmosphere. Natural smartphone photography, realistic skin texture, authentic satin reflections, soft chiffon transparency, natural fabric wrinkles, subtle HDR, gentle smartphone sharpening, realistic depth, no CGI, no studio lighting, no AI artifacts, no exaggerated anatomy.
